title: Elephant holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 34 Q58 48 54 60' stroke='#9ad8ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='22' rx='11' ry='13' fill='#ff5a7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='22' rx='11' ry='13' fill='none' stroke='#ff9db0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='17' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#ffc2ce'/>
  <polygon points='63,34 60,38 66,38' fill='#e63a5c'/>
  <!-- Elephant body -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='62' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='58' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#a5bcd8'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='72' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#7a94b8'/>
  <rect x='46' y='72' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#7a94b8'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M18 60 Q10 58 12 66' stroke='#8fa8c8' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='50' r='15' fill='#a5bcd8'/>
  <!-- Ear -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#c9d8ea'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='64' cy='45' r='2.5' fill='#2c3a52'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='44' r='1' fill='#e8f2ff'/>
  <!-- Trunk -->
  <path d='M72 52 Q80 56 78 66 Q76 72 70 70' stroke='#a5bcd8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M78 66 Q76 72 70 70' stroke='#8fa8c8' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Trunk holding string end -->
  <circle cx='69' cy='69' r='3.5' fill='#8fa8c8'/>
  <!-- Tusk -->
  <path d='M68 58 Q72 62 70 66' stroke='#fdf6e3' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
